verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Ramp has a Developer API, OpenAPI spec, and an official MCP server, but nothing describes issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials/tokens specifically for AI agents (e.g., granular API key permissions, agent-specific auth scopes). Missing for 10: documentation of scoped API key/token creation, permission granularity controls for agent credentials, and any hands-on confirmation of least-privilege agent access.
